card.name: Starts of words beginning with ex
card.fires_on: Word starts or hyphen joints where the next piece is likely to begin with "ex" (excessive, exposed, excretion, exhibitors). Also a few sentence-opening words such as "In" or "für" that precede it.

modes.label: Ex- word start
modes.description: The piece "ex" or "-ex" that begins a word like excessive, exposed, excretion or exceeded.

modes.label: Hyphen before ex-
modes.description: A hyphen joining a term to a following ex- word such as excretion or exposed.
modes.example: paroxetine<<-ex>>posed infants were primarily ventricular septal

modes.label: Sentence-opening link word
modes.description: A short opening word such as In or für that is not itself an ex- piece.
modes.example: << In>> the past century the Church has grown both

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like experimental and experiment, which fit an ex- start.
card.plain: It fires on the start of words that begin with "ex", such as excessive or exposed.
